title: Nuevo Laredo Invests 8.9 Million Pesos in Street Lighting and Paving Across Four Colonias
excerpt: The Government of Nuevo Laredo delivered 8.9 million pesos in public lighting and paving works in the San Roberto, Ejido La Unión, 150 Aniversario and Vamos Tamaulipas colonias, including 40 new LED lights along Radial 3.
content:
The Government of Nuevo Laredo delivered 8.9 million pesos in public lighting and paving works in four colonias, in a push to improve mobility and road safety for families across the border city.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal led the delivery of the works in the San Roberto, Ejido La Unión, 150 Aniversario and Vamos Tamaulipas colonias. Together, the projects add 1,354 linear meters of new public lighting and more than 2,300 square meters of paving, along with water and sewer line renewal, sidewalks, curbs and signage.

One of the largest projects was the public lighting along Radial 3, between Carretera Aeropuerto and the Rotonda El Conejo, a stretch that connects San Roberto and Ejido La Unión and serves freight traffic headed to the World Trade Bridge. With a 3 million peso investment, the city installed 40 light poles and 40 LED fixtures along 1,354 linear meters, with the bases, wiring and electrical equipment needed to run them.

In the 150 Aniversario colonia, the city paved sections of Evarista Guerra and Irineo Escamilla streets with asphalt, a 3.9 million peso project covering more than 1,370 square meters, including renewed household water and sewer connections, sidewalks, curbs, signage and lighting.

The works also included paving Lagos de Moreno street in the Vamos Tamaulipas colonia, with an investment of nearly 2 million pesos over more than 926 square meters.

Canturosas Villarreal said road modernization must also include renewing the underground drinking water and sewer networks, so the new pavement lasts longer.
